description: How NVIDIA's AI surge vaporized decades of chip hierarchies — vs Intel's slide and TSMC's foundry dominance (2006–2026).
youtube_description:
The AI Chip Tsunami — the raw numbers behind one of the fastest corporate ascents in modern history.

This visualization tracks year‑end market capitalizations (in billions USD) for NVIDIA, Intel, TSMC, AMD and Qualcomm from 2006 through 2026. Watch how NVIDIA went from a niche GPU maker to a dominant AI titan after datacenter GPU demand (2020–2024) — and how legacy leaders like Intel struggled through manufacturing delays and strategy shifts while TSMC scaled into the world's foundry king. AMD's Zen comeback and Qualcomm's steady mobile play are also visible in the waves.

If you like dramatic chart races and deep dives into tech power shifts, hit Like, Subscribe and ring the bell — and drop a comment: which chipmaker do you think rules the next decade?

Sources: public company market caps and company filings; year‑end market values reflected as billions USD.

Chapters: 0:00 Intro 0:12 2006–2016 setup 1:05 2017–2019 crypto/gaming volatility 1:44 2020 AI ramp 2:20 2023–2026 consolidation
